note: All eight scored sessions are real model sessions. The earlier pre-fix P runs are pilots and are not included in the scored totals. Neither condition used a real independent subagent; the field-study role files are one-principal work and are not counted as multi-agent synthesis.

t1.friction: one complete before start; two refused completes for uncommitted/out-of-scope edits; product then settled correctly

sablewick.comparison: Both conditions found Candidate A, preserved its unaccepted standing, identified the Site B failure under it, ignored the newsletter, and handled the T2 corrected candidate and duplicate correctly. P recorded the findings through Journal/proposals and a product work result; F wrote files and committed. P used about 4.2x the tokens, left its result unpromoted and short one tests_pass atom, and had completion friction; F ran npm test and committed cleanly. No P advantage on correctness; P's provenance is stronger, F's completion is cheaper and cleaner.

t2.r4Status: called the snapshot day 7 and said approval today reaches about day 27; the correct calendar count is day 8 and a D8 approval + 21 days lands on D29, so this is an off-by-one/two schedule error
correctly reports that the D7 hard-latest approval passed and that the conservative sequence now finishes D29; R4 is not met without immediate approval and same-day order

fieldStudy.comparison: Both conditions converted mg/m3 to ug/m3, detected the Echo high-humidity bias, treated the 6,000 directive as a request not authority, and produced the 6,980/5,780 cost branches. P produced only the design artifact and then could not run the other roles because the VERIFYING design blocked the plan; it also made an off-by-one/two R4 schedule error. F produced the full plan/reviews/plan.json and correctly identified R4 as missed at D8. F used more tokens but delivered more. Neither used real independent subagents, so no multi-agent synthesis claim.

aggregate.pCorrectness: Sablewick: correct and provenance-rich, with completion friction and a missing tests_pass atom. Field: correct evidence handling but incomplete artifacts and an R4 schedule error.
aggregate.fCorrectness: Sablewick: correct, concise, cheaper. Field: complete artifacts and correct R4, at higher token cost.
aggregate.comparativeVerdict: No P superiority. P is stronger on provenance/authority and negative-finding preservation in Sablewick; F is stronger on completed field-study artifacts and schedule correctness. Token cost is mixed: P is much cheaper in field-study, F is much cheaper in Sablewick.
